title: PPT Slide Spec
description: One slide's semantic design with optional page purpose, without title, hierarchy, placement, or page number.

core.description: The main takeaway the audience should retain from this page, not its title or a list of layout instructions.

type.description: Representation of this element: text for prose, list for items, metric for a key figure, quote for a quotation, table for tabular values, chart for data, diagram for relationships, code for a code sample, or asset for visual media. content_comparison is a page purpose; choose chart, table or diagram for a comparison element.

intent.description: What this element should communicate: the relevant content, evidence or relationship and its purpose on the page. Describe the intended content in natural language without inventing missing facts.

items.description: One planned content element, pairing a representation type with its communication intent.

elements.description: Ordered content elements planned for this page. Supplying this list replaces it completely; [] clears it. Each element describes what to communicate and how to represent it, not HTML source.

layout.description: Natural-language suggestion for arranging this page's content and reading order, such as a chart on the left and explanation on the right; not a template identifier or CSS.

purpose.description: Optional narrative purpose, not a visual template. `cover` for topic and identity; `introduction` for background, problem, goals or structure; `transition` for a chapter change; `content_explanation` for concepts or facts; `content_comparison` for differences or tradeoffs; `content_example` for concrete cases; `content_guidance` for methods or recommendations; `content_other` for a known body-content mode outside these categories; `conclusion` for summary, conclusions or actions; `other` for a known page role outside these categories. Choose the dominant purpose for mixed content; leave unset when undetermined.
